description: This file is a shell script used for testing the summary functionality of Git submodules. It sets up repositories, adds files and submodules, and verifies the output of 'git submodule summary' under various scenarios.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds files to a submodule, commits them, and returns the short commit hash.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Creates a commit with a message.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository in a specified directory.
